notes.title: PATCH NOTES VERSION 0.2
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the release of our new Demo Version 0.2! After receiving valuable feedback during the Steam Next Fest, we’ve taken the time to polish every aspect of the game, and now we’re ready to share the improvements with you.

In this new version, you’ll be able to explore a revamped visual identity that reflects the essence of the world of Madora. In addition, we’ve introduced new gameplay mechanics that will challenge your skills and allow you to create even more creative builds. And for story lovers, we’re excited to introduce the first part of our immersive story!

🗓 Release Date: 04/25 🗓

On this date, we invite all interested parties to become our early testers. To participate, just send us a message on our Discord.

And the news doesn’t stop there! At the end of May, we will release version 0.3, which will bring one of the most anticipated features: multiplayer! Gather your friends and come save the world of Madora from the clutches of Árodam.

👉 Join our community on Discord and be part of this epic journey!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes 

We fixed the behavior of Karús in the air, the freezing of monsters at spawn, the Warrior's skill and the passives of Frost Nova and Heat Wave are now working.

 Optimization 

Listening to the feedback from our community, we tried to optimize the map to run at higher fps. In addition, we changed the character selection screen aiming at better performance and game fluidity.

 New Skill 

Introducing our newest skill: Air Slash!!! With gusts of wind that hit several enemies, it also comes with an extra bonus: it destroys the projectiles of enemies it encounters along the way! For those who want to hit harder, its passive increases the chances of a critical hit, for the first time in the game.

We are committed to further optimizing the game while launching new features to make it increasingly rich in gameplay, don't miss the next updates by following us on social media.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.4
notes.content:
First Boss 

We are very happy to include our first boss in the game! No spoilers, but it is a creature that will be challenging and will require a lot of skills from our players. It awaits you at Wave 9!

Lore

After much thought, we decided to start including the game's lore in the demo. Rhara will guide you and tell you about Madora's challenges in each wave, assembling the puzzle pieces piece by piece.


 Minor settings fixes 

We have improved control and the audiovisual experience, adding several controls for the player to shape their experience as they find most enjoyable.

notes.title: PATCH 0.1.3
notes.content:
New languages ​​

We have added the option of English, Spanish and French. Just open the menu on the home screen and change the language, thus changing all the game interfaces and gameplay stories.

 Enemy size adjustments 

Enemies now have varying sizes, generated randomly with each run. So on each journey the player will find a different adventure with monsters of unique sizes.


 Minor fix 

We fixed enemy spawns, the new frost passive and several small gameplay adjustments.

notes.title: PATCH 0.1.2
notes.content:
Collectable XP system

Now enemies do not automatically provide xp, but rather drop orbs of xp essence that have to be collected and thus accumulate experience to level up the character.

Camera system

Now you can not only zoom in on the camera, but you can also zoom out and see the game from further away, thus better adapting the experience for each type of player.


Skills tutorial

The first time between waves 4 and 5 the screen appears for you to assemble your build between active and passive, now with a tutorial you will follow this process for the first time and guide you through the process.

notes.title: PATCH 0.1.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes

Rhara's health bar fix
Automatically from the sixth skill onwards it goes to passive
Link to official discord fixed

Enemy balancing

Introducing variation in enemy generation
Goblins are now more dangerous
Mini description of each wave

Incremental improvements

Pressing "esc" or "p" button pauses the game and goes to the mid-game menu
Death animation intro
Increased basic attack damage depending on the character's level
